name: How much does the sting hurt?
question: Schmidt sting pain index: entomologist Justin Schmidt rated the pain of insect stings he received, from 1 (mild) to 4 (excruciating).

items.name: Potter wasp
items.fact: One of the few stings Schmidt rated below 1.

items.name: Sweat bee
items.fact: Schmidt: "Light and ephemeral, almost fruity. A tiny spark has singed a single hair on your arm."

items.name: Red fire ant
items.fact: Schmidt: "Like walking across a shag carpet and reaching for the light switch."

items.name: Mud dauber wasp
items.fact: Schmidt: "Jalapeño cheese when you were expecting Havarti."

items.name: Paper wasp
items.fact: Schmidt: "A single drop of superheated frying oil landed on your arm."

items.name: Honey bee
items.fact: Schmidt used the honey bee sting, rated 2, as the anchor for his whole scale.

items.name: Bumble bee
items.fact: Schmidt: "Colorful flames. Fireworks land on your arm."

items.name: Yellowjacket wasp
items.fact: Schmidt: "Imagine W. C. Fields extinguishing a cigar on your tongue."

items.name: Bald-faced hornet
items.fact: Schmidt: "Similar to getting your hand mashed in a revolving door."

items.name: Jack jumper ant
items.fact: Schmidt: "The oven mitt had a hole in it when you pulled the cookies out of the oven."

items.name: Trap-jaw ant
items.fact: Trap-jaw ants snap their jaws shut faster than almost any other animal movement.

items.name: Honey bee sting on the tongue
items.fact: Schmidt: "For 10 minutes life is not worth living."

items.name: Florida harvester ant
items.fact: Schmidt: "Somebody is using a power drill to excavate your ingrown toenail."

items.name: Red paper wasp
items.fact: Schmidt: "Like spilling a beaker of hydrochloric acid on a paper cut."

items.name: Bullet ant
items.fact: Schmidt: "Like walking over flaming charcoal with a 3-inch nail embedded in your heel."

items.name: Tarantula hawk wasp
items.fact: Schmidt: "A running hair dryer has just been dropped into your bubble bath."

items.name: Warrior wasp
items.fact: Schmidt: "You are chained in the flow of an active volcano."
